name: ben-mods
description: Claude Code mods by bencsmartucph: an outside reviewer, an issue board, a readable terminal transcript and a few small tools

plugins.name: outside
plugins.description: /outside [question]: an outside reviewer (Sonnet, no history) reads a digest of your prompts and the replies and answers

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: /backlog: the repo's open GitHub issues as a board or list, press one to read it, work on it

plugins.name: readable
plugins.description: Terminal transcript in three levels: you bar, one-line tools, claude label, clickable file links

plugins.name: dictation
plugins.description: /fix: rewrites a dictated reply so Claude reads it as meant, using the conversation

plugins.name: cache-dot
plugins.description: Minutes left on the prompt cache as a dot after the footer's mode labels (grey, yellow, red cold); estimated, not the statusline's figures

plugins.name: session-notify
plugins.description: Windows toast titled with the session's name, saying what it needs or how the turn ended
